exact_objects.gcDCQS(18^4:2): 74 points: stem S of 2 points, four groups of 18. Blocks are 4-subsets; every 3-subset not contained in S ∪ G for a group G lies in exactly one block, none inside any S ∪ G (60,264 covered triples, 15,066 blocks). For x in a group G: derived design on X\{x} is an incomplete STS(73,19) with hole (G ∪ S)\{x}; it must be a gcSTS(73,19): partition into r = chi'(73) = 37 partial parallel classes of X\{x}, exactly s = 37 − (73 − 19)/2 = 10 of them avoiding the hole. For each stem point α: the derived design (X\S, groups, A_α) is a GDD(2,3,72) of type 18^4 and must be a Kirkman frame KF(18^4): classes each a parallel class of X\(S ∪ G) for some group G (source LF 237–240, 281–288).
exact_objects.FDGDD(3,4,5{18}): A GDD(3,4,90) of type 18^5 (transverse quadruples; every transverse triple once) whose derived design at every point is a KF(18^4) (LF 241–247). Equivalent to Chang–Zheng–Zhou's FDH(5,18,4,3) by definition.
exact_objects.RDGDD(3,4,5{18}): The same GDD whose derived design at every point is a resolvable GDD(2,3,72) of type 18^4 (full parallel classes of the 72 points) (LF 243–245).
